description: Closest-item crosswalk from the repository’s current Warhammer: The Old World catalogue to Mordheim. Equivalents are item-type analogies, not rules conversions; null means no direct Mordheim equipment equivalent. Faction equipment names include creature attack profiles and war machines as represented in the source catalogue. mordheimEquipmentCostValues gives fixed prices or min/max ranges in gold crowns for the mapped Mordheim equipment.
